The climate in Koper

Koper is about 19 m above sea level. The warmest month is August, with an average high of 29°C; the coldest is January, when nights average 2°C. Around 1280 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in September (about 179 mm). The highest temperature in Koper in 2015–2024 was 36°C (23 July 2022) and the lowest −7°C (26 February 2018).

Best time to visit Koper

The most pleasant weather in Koper is usually in June and September: average highs are between 24°C and 26°C, with up to 10 days of rain a month.
